cleaner.label: Cargo cache
cleaner.description: Archives, sources and indexes downloaded by Cargo, all rebuildable. Does not touch installed binaries, configuration or credentials.

option.label: Cargo compressed downloads
option.description: Removes the compressed .crate archives downloaded by Cargo (registry\cache).
option.warning: Archives are re-downloaded on the next `cargo build` or `cargo fetch`: avoid if you work offline.

option.label: Extracted dependency sources
option.description: Removes the sources extracted from the .crate archives (registry\src). Cargo extracts them again on next use.

option.label: Registry index
option.description: Removes the local registry index (registry\index): version and dependency metadata of the crates.
option.warning: The index is re-downloaded on the next `cargo fetch` or `cargo update`: network required.

option.label: Git dependency checkouts
option.description: Removes the extracted copies of git dependencies (git\checkouts). Cargo recreates them from the git database on next use.

option.label: Git dependency database
option.description: Removes the clones of the git repositories used as dependencies (git\db).
option.warning: The repositories are re-downloaded on the next `cargo fetch`: network required.
